title: Iki environment binding (iki/v1)
description: How a plugin's environment runs in this deployment: the compute templates it runs on, and the labels its self-hosted runs need. For each job, Iki picks the template with the lowest priority number it fits, then the smallest of those.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this manifest follows.

environment.description: The plugin and its environment, such as `iki/protein.structure-tools`.

templates.description: The compute templates its jobs may run on, with the order they're tried in.

priority.description: Lower numbers are tried first, such as spot (0) before on-demand (1). Defaults to 0.

labels.description: Labels this deployment's machines must have for the environment's self-hosted runs, besides the ones the environment names, such as `lab-3` for the instruments its runs drive here (ADR 0112). Only for an environment on the self-hosted tier.
